reddit.title: Introducing a New Approach to Unit Movement in Provincia
reddit.body: In our latest devtalk, we explore significant improvements to unit movement mechanics in Provincia. Formation drags now follow your pull direction accurately, ensuring that soldiers slide into their positions without any teleportation. This update enhances the realism of battles, allowing for smoother transitions and more strategic gameplay. Discover the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
